mentions.name: CreateRotiBomBot
mentions.description: A Telegram bot that creates daily photo-sharing chat groups to help families stay connected abroad. Each morning the bot posts a simple topic (e.g. "Garden" or "Anything halal") and everyone in the chat responds by taking a picture of the object. Originally built for the author's own family calls-and-games group, it now lets others suggest topics via the bot, supports multiple chats, and has hosted 11 chats since November 2025. Free to use.
mentions.problem: After migrating to another country, it is hard to talk with parents, sisters, and grandmas as much as when living back home, and scheduled weekly calls often fail because someone can never make it.
mentions.audience: Families spread across countries who struggle to stay connected, open for anyone to try.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got an idea to create a small chat, share a simple topic every morning and then let everyone take a picture of the object. For example, recently we had "Garden" which made my grandma in the countryside go outside and take a picture of her growing strawberries.
